passages.original: Ostend l etiam admonitio ista quod nullus se unquam in veritate poterit excusare quod veram charitatem habere nOli poss t. Aliquas enim sententias de homilia S. Augustini quam de charitate scripsit, prout nobis opportunum visum est, huic sermoni credimus inserendas.
passages.english: This admonition also shows that no one will ever truly be able to excuse himself [on the ground] that he cannot have true charity. For we have thought it right to insert into this sermon some sentences from the homily of St Augustine which he wrote on charity, as seemed fitting to us.
passages.notes: Scanning errors corrected: "Ostend l" read as "Ostendit", "nOli poss t" as "non possit".
